items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: But Herb left and then they had another fellow named Edgar Allen, he was from St. Louis. So I'm up there and I'm hearing that going on

ctx.x: Yeah, because the music was there.

But he wasn't famous. And I was there. And at first the first trumpet, his name was Herb Branch, Herb Branch was from Boston. He was a great trumpet player, he was a great classical trumpet player. But Herb left and then they had another fellow named Edgar Allen, he was from St. Louis.

So I'm up there and I'm hearing that going on, you know, feeling good, happy. But I was having too much romance. Oh, romance was something else. I never had so much romance. One morning I picked that horn up and didn't nothing come out. Didn't nothing come out. I said, Oh, my goodness. I went to the doctor and he said well, where do you work?" and I said, I work two sets, and you come off there 8:00 o'clock, 9:00 o'clock, 10:00 o'clock, 11:00 o'clock. And you start at 11:00 o'clock at night. Well, I would be…
